import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { MarketOverview, MarketOverviewService } from './market-overview.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-market-overview', templateUrl: './market-overview.component.html', styleUrls: ['./market-overview.component.css'] }) export class MarketOverviewComponent implements OnInit { overview?: MarketOverview; loading = true; constructor(private marketOverviewService: MarketOverviewService) { } ngOnInit(): void { this.marketOverviewService.getOverview().subscribe({ next: data => { this.overview = data; this.loading = false; }, error: err => { console.error(err); this.loading = false; } }); } }
